title: Phoenicians crossed the Atlantic and mined copper in the Great Lakes

tellings.quote: I think they crossed the Atlantic I think they were mining copper >> in the great lakes

plain: Tim Alberino, a researcher, believes the ancient Phoenicians sailed across the Atlantic and mined copper around the Great Lakes of North America. He tells Michels "I think they crossed the Atlantic, I think they were mining copper in the Great Lakes," and names no source. If he is right, sailors from the Old World reached the heart of America long before Columbus.
